# v10 — scoring across the nation {#sec-release-v10}

```{r}
#| include: false
# The full chapter lives in releases/_v10-body.qmd (the leading underscore keeps
# Quarto from rendering it on its own). It renders in the v10 book, and in every
# book once the registry lists v10 as public. Until then a restricted release
# must never reach GitHub Pages (CLAUDE.md), so the public books of the other
# releases carry only the short note below, with no link to the review host.
# doc_access() fails closed for a version the published registry does not list.
v10_row    <- doc_version_row("v10")
v10_public <- nrow(v10_row) == 1 && !is.na(v10_row$ver[1]) &&
  identical(doc_access("v10"), "public")
v10_full   <- identical(doc_ver(), "v10") || v10_public
```

```{r}
#| label: v10-body
#| output: asis
if (v10_full) {
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    here::here("releases/_v10-body.qmd"), quiet = TRUE, envir = environment()))
} else {
  cat(
"::: {.callout-note}
## A release under review

v10 is a pre-release under review. It adds a second score beside the within-ecoregion one: each
species' share of its whole modelled range, weighted by extinction risk and expressed per square
kilometre against the national average, so that Program Areas in different ecoregions can be compared.
It is built on v8's data with no ingest or merge re-run, and v8's own metrics are kept unchanged as
the control. Its chapter (the method, the three denominators, the flags and what moved in the
Program-Area scores) is published with the v10 documentation on the signed-in review host, and
appears in every version of this book once v10 is released.
:::
")
}
```
